verdict.rationale: Deel's API and MCP server expose payroll data (and contracts, people, time data) that an agent could pull via API calls or MCP tools like listOfContracts, and sandbox/webhook infrastructure supports building such integrations. However, there is no explicit evidence of a 'payroll journal' entry format, GL-code export, or reconciliation-into-ledger capability (e.g., no mention of accounting export formats or ledger-sync tools). missing for 10: dedicated payroll journal/GL export endpoint, explicit reconciliation or ledger-sync tooling, evidence of accounting-system integration.
